units.source_text: 柏木喘着粗气，靠墙支持着身子。

en.t: Kashiwagi was breathing heavily, supporting himself against the wall.

units.source_text: 樟树摇曳的叶影，给他那副总是憔悴的脸增添了光彩，并投以奇妙地跃动的影子。

en.t: The swaying shadows of the camphor leaves added a gleam to his always haggard face and cast strangely dancing shadows over it.

units.source_text: 也许是与他不相称的红砖的反衬下才显得这样的吧。

en.t: Perhaps it only appeared that way against the contrasting red brick, which did not suit him.
